literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe the same construct: YFP fused to the N-terminal cytoplasmic tail of ATP1B2. The topology landmarks place the N-terminus (residues 1–40) unambiguously in the intracellular compartment; the single TM helix (41–61) is followed by the entire extracellular domain (62–290). Because the tag faces the cytoplasm and neither line describes a snorkel arrangement, this insertion does not qualify as an extracellular surface-tag site. No ledger line reports any tag, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon hit, or epitope insertion anywhere in the extracellular domain (residues 62–290), including the extracellular C-terminus (residue 290). Zero sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: YFP fused to the N-terminal cytoplasmic tail (residues 1–40) of full-length ATP1B2; tag is on the intracellular face, not the extracellular surface.
